name: But You Are
source:
When I saw the theme "You're not them" it turned out to be the perfect one to let out some feelings I've been having.

This is a vent game.  It talks about abuse, recovery, and feeling like you are your awful parent(s).  If that will trigger you, don't read it.

[From [url=https://norbez.itch.io/but-you-are]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当我看到“你不是他们”这个主题时，它是发泄我一直以来的一些感受的完美选择。

这是一个发泄游戏。它谈论了虐待、康复以及感觉自己是糟糕的父母。如果这会触发你，请不要阅读它。

[来自[url=https://norbez.itch.io/but-you-are]itch.io[/url]]
